name: Eternal Life
overview: Scripture reveals that eternal life is a fundamental reality beyond physical death, where the spirit returns to God who gave it, as Ecclesiastes 12:7 explains. Jesus teaches the serious consequences of rejecting God, warning that the soul can be destroyed in hell, a place of everlasting fire prepared for the devil and his angels (Matthew 10:28; 25:41). The final judgment separates the righteous, who enter into eternal life, from the wicked, who face everlasting punishment (Matthew 25:46). Jesus’ promise to the repentant thief affirms the hope of immediate presence with Him in paradise after death (Luke 23:43), underscoring the personal and eternal nature of salvation.
